verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe container tags as hard, namespace-level isolation boundaries ('memories in one tag are never returned by a search scoped to another tag', 'every memory tagged with user_alex lives in its own isolated space, completely separate from... user_jordan'), with code examples showing per-user/tenant scoping on add and search calls, and guidance to scope each end-user or tenant to a container tag for compliance/deletion workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that isolation holds in practice (e.g. no audited or community-reported leak test), and explicit agent-level (vs user/tenant-level) scoping examples.
